title: Certify Staging Gateway exact-release drift with bound degraded baseline and verified rollback

phases.objective: Close the Staging Gateway exact-commit drift certification deadlock without weakening fail-closed /ready or permitting provider changes before exact-bound authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Prepare an exact SHA and policy-bound certification plan when the live Worker is healthy but /ready is 503 due to source identity drift.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Only release identity mismatch is eligible, a publicly ready exact-build candidate is certified, and the prior degraded Worker baseline is restored with provider inventory and public identity evidence; live Staging certification remains mandatory.
steps: Observe exact canonical Staging source and policy plus healthy Worker /health identity.
Classify the narrowly allowed 503 upstream source-commit mismatch and reject stale, policy mismatch and unrelated 503 errors.
Bind the original Worker source and baseline mode to encrypted plan digest.
Deploy a synthetic candidate with exact public /health and /ready proof.
Roll back to the old Worker deployment and prove its exact original degraded state including 503 reason, without falsely claiming trust readiness.
Require independent live Staging certification and new exact-bound operator authority before any provider execution.
assertions: Healthy exact baseline and drift-only baseline are both supported.
Every non-release-identity failure is rejected; normal Gateway /ready remains fail-closed.
Source, policy and baseline mode must be unchanged from plan to apply.
The candidate must attain exact public healthy/ready identity before rollback.
Provider inventory, public health and original degraded readiness are verified after rollback.
The resulting certification evidence distinguishes restored degraded baseline from public trust restoration.
No live Cloudflare, DNS, custom-domain, database or Production mutation occurs in synthetic test.
